note: Mouth shapes for lip sync as ARKit weights (0..1), keyed through the face table. A-H and X are Preston Blair's mouth shapes as Rhubarb Lip Sync names them: A closed (P, B, M), B slightly open with teeth together (K, S, T, EE), C open (EH, AE), D wide open (AA), E slightly rounded (AO, ER), F puckered (UW, OW, W), G teeth on the lower lip (F, V), H tongue up (L), X at rest. open, rounded and wide are the audio analysis's vowel classes; their weights are scaled by the loudness, so their jawOpen follows the loudness. Most mouth shapes only move bones, so without Move face bones only the jaw moves.
